salen: salir — they come out, go out (present 3rd pl.; reçebir lo salen 'they come out to welcome him'; = salen)
firió: ferir — he struck (preterite 3rd sg.; a tierras firió 'he came down to the ground', dismounted, Pidal 'echó pie a tierra'; = hirió)
comidía: comedir — he was thinking of, had in mind, planned (imperfect 3rd sg., -ía; commo lo comidía 'as he had planned it', Pidal 'como pensaba', 'como había dispuesto'; = pensaba)
yerbas: yerba — grass, herbs (pl.; las yerbas del campo 'the grass of the field'; = hierbas)
dientes: diente — tooth (pl.; a dientes 'with the teeth'; = dientes)
tomó: tomar — he took (preterite 3rd sg.; a dientes las tomó 'he took them with his teeth'; = tomó)
omildança: omildança — humility, homage, reverence (dar omildança 'to do homage'; Pidal 'acatamiento'; = humildad, acatamiento)
levantados: levantar + (v)os — raise yourself, get up (imperative 2nd pl. levantad + enclitic vos, the v lost after -d; Levantados en pie 'rise to your feet'; = levantaos)
hinojos: hinojo — knee (pl.; hinojos fitos 'on bended knees'; = hinojos; cf. inojos)
fitos: fito — fixed, planted firm (adj. masc. pl., Latin fictus; hinojos fitos 'knees planted on the ground'; = hincados)
dédesme: dar + me — (that) you give me (present subjunctive 2nd pl. dedes + enclitic me, optative/request; dédesme vuestra amor 'may you grant me your favour'; = me deis)
oyan: oír — they hear (present subjunctive 3rd pl.; que lo oyan todos 'so that all may hear it'; = oigan)
perdono: perdonar — I pardon (present 1st sg.; aquí vos perdono 'here I pardon you'; = perdono)
ên: e + en — and in (Pidal's circumflex marks the two words run together, as in lâ, lês, mê, âquel; ên todo mio reyno 'and in all my kingdom'; = y en)
desde: desde — from, since (preposition; desde oy 'from today'; = desde)
levós: levar + se — he rose, got up (levóse: preterite 3rd sg. levó + enclitic reflexive se, final e dropped; levós en pie 'he got to his feet'; = se levantó)
bócal: boca + le — the mouth ... him (boca + enclitic dative le, e dropped, the pronoun hung on the noun before the verb; en la bócal saludó 'greeted him on the mouth', Pidal 'le besó en la boca'; = le saludó en la boca)
valer: valer — to help, avail, protect (infinitive; in the split future valer me a 'will help me', infinitive + me + a = ha; = me valdrá)
fossedes: seer — (that) you were, would you were (imperfect subjunctive 2nd pl., -sse type, strong stem fo-; Fossedes mio huesped 'would you were my guest'; = fueseis)
huesped: huesped — guest (also host; mio huesped seredes 'you will be my guest'; = huésped)
ploguiesse: plazer — it might please (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., strong stem plogu-, -sse; si vos ploguiesse 'if it pleased you'; = pluguiese/placiera)
llegastes: llegar — you arrived (preterite 2nd pl., -astes; vos agora llegastes 'you have just arrived'; = llegasteis)
viniemos: venir — we came (strong preterite 1st pl.; nos viniemos anoch 'we came yesterday'; = vinimos)
otorgó: otorgar — he granted, agreed (preterite 3rd sg.; lo otorgó 'he agreed to it'; = otorgó)
omillan: omillar — they bow, humble themselves; greet (present 3rd pl., reflexive; se le omillan 'they bow to him, greet him', Pidal omillarse a uno 'saludarle'; = se humillan, saludan)
omillámosnos: omillar + nos — we bow, we greet you (present 1st pl. omillamos + enclitic reflexive nos, the -s of -mos kept before nos; = nos humillamos, os saludamos)
andamos: andar — we go about, act (present 1st pl.; andamos en vuestro pro 'we go about in your interest'; = andamos)
fartar: fartar — to satiate, have enough (infinitive, reflexive; non se puede fartar dél 'he cannot get enough of him'; = hartarse)
tántol: tanto + le — so much ... him (tanto 'so much' + enclitic le 'him', e dropped; tántol querie de coraçón 'so much he loved him from the heart'; = tanto le quería)
catándol: catar + le — looking at him / at his (gerund catando + enclitic le, e dropped; catándol sedie la barba 'he sat gazing at his beard', le the person whose beard it is; = mirándole)
aínal: aína + le — so soon ... on him (aína 'quickly, soon' + enclitic dative le, e dropped; tan aínal creçió 'grew on him so soon', Pidal tan aína 'tan pronto'; = tan pronto le)
maravíllanse: maravillar — they marvel (present 3rd pl., reflexive se enclitic; maravíllanse de mio Çid 'they marvel at mio Çid'; = se maravillan)
claro: claro — bright, clear (adj. masc. sg., here predicative; claro salie el sol 'the sun rose bright'; = claro)
salie: salir — it came out, rose (imperfect 3rd sg., -ie; claro salie el sol 'the sun was rising bright'; = salía)
adobassen: adobar — they prepare, make ready (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl., -sse, after mandar que; que adobassen cozina 'that they should prepare a meal'; = adobasen/prepararan)
cozina: cozina — cooking, kitchen; here the meal prepared (adobar cozina 'to prepare a meal'; sense 'meal' from context; = cocina)
acuerdan: acordar — they agree (present 3rd pl.; acuerdan en una razón 'they agree with one voice'; = concuerdan, se ponen de acuerdo)
comieran: comer — they had eaten (pluperfect indicative in -ra, 3rd pl.; no comieran mejor 'they had not eaten better'; = habían comido)

__broaden__.querie: querer — it was about to (imperfect 3rd sg., unaccented spelling of querié; el sol querie apuntar 'the sun was about to rise'; = quería) · also querer — he wanted, loved (imperfect 3rd sg.; cavalleros que querie de coraçón 'knights he loved from the heart'; tántol querie 'he loved him so much'; = quería)
__broaden__.unos: uno — some (masc. pl.; unos … otros 'some … others') · also unos + number — 'about, some' (unos quinze 'some fifteen'; = unos quince)
__broaden__.sedie: seer — he was sitting, he sat (imperfect 3rd sg. of seer 'to sit', unaccented -ie; = estaba sentado) · also seer — he was, kept (doing) (imperfect 3rd sg. as auxiliary/copula; Hinojos fitos sedie 'he was on bended knees'; catándol sedie 'he kept gazing at him'; = estaba)
__broaden__.sabe: saber — she knows (present 3rd sg.; = sabe) · also saber — he knows (how to) (present 3rd sg. + infinitive; sabe dar omildança 'he knows how to do homage'; = sabe)
__broaden__.demás: demás — besides, in addition · also los demás — 'the rest, all the others' (Todos los demás 'all the others'; = los demás)
__broaden__.mando: mandar — I promise, vow; I order (present 1st sg.) · also mandar — he ordered (preterite 3rd sg., unaccented spelling of mandó; el Campeador a los sos lo mando 'the Campeador ordered his men'; = mandó)
__broaden__.avie: aver — he had (imperfect; unaccented spelling beside avié) · also aver — impersonal temporal 'it had been' (passado avie tres años 'three years had passed'; = hacía/habían pasado)
__broaden__.paga: pagar — is pleased, is satisfied (present 3rd sg., reflexive se paga; de coraçón se paga 'is heartily pleased'; = se paga, se alegra) · also pagar — pleases, satisfies (present 3rd sg., transitive with object pronoun; los paga mio Çid 'mio Çid pleases/satisfies them'; = los complace)
__broaden__.feremos: fazer — we shall make, win (future 1st pl., syncopated; feremos ganançia 'we shall make gain'; = haremos) · also fazer — we shall do (feremos lo que ploguiere a vos 'we shall do what pleases you'; = haremos)
__broaden__.parte: parte — part, side (de parte de los moros 'on the Moors' side'; = parte) · also partir (se) — he parts, leaves (present 3rd sg. of partir, with non se le: que nos le parte de so braço 'who does not leave his side'; = se aparta) · also partir — it divides, separates (present 3rd sg., transitive; la sierra, que las otras tierras parte 'the sierra that divides the other lands'; = separa) · also parte — share, place, footing (with dar: dovos … parte 'I give you a place', Pidal 'os doy acogida en mi reino'; = parte, acogida)
__broaden__.razón: razón — talk, speech, matter (dexad essa razón 'leave off that talk'; esta razón 'this matter'; = razón, here closest asunto, conversación) · also razón — 'word, voice' (en una razón 'with one voice, in agreement'; = razón)
__broaden__.estar: estar — to stand, be (infinitive after veer; tres reyes veo … derredor de mí estar 'I see three kings standing about me'; = estar) · also estar — to stay, remain (a todos los sos estar los mandó 'he ordered all his men to stay'; = quedarse)
__broaden__.si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us') · also si — si'nulla = sin + nulla with -n assimilated before n- (si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = sin ningún miedo, sin ninguna duda) · also si non — 'except, but for' (si non a estos cavalleros 'except these knights'; = salvo)
__broaden__.quanto: quanto — as much as, whatever (= cuanto) · quanto ella mejor sabe 'as best she can' (quanto + comparative 'as much as') · also 'how much' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'as far/fast as' (quanto pueden andar) · tanto quanto 'as long as'; por quanto … ha 'for all that there is' (por quanto en el mundo ha) · also en quanto — 'as far as, insofar as' (En quanto podemos 'as far as we are able'; = en cuanto)
__broaden__.tierras: tierra — land (pl.; = tierras) · also a tierras — 'to the ground' (a tierras firió 'he dismounted', Pidal 'echó pie a tierra'; = a tierra)
__broaden__.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado) · personal a before a direct object (salvest a Jonás; a ti adoro); a + inf. 'to, about to' (tornólas a catar); a tan grand sabor 'with so great pleasure'; a ojo 'in plain sight' · also a — 'into' (sacar a çelada 'to lure into ambush'); 'at, in' (a la çaga 'at the rear'); 'against' (dar salto a la çaga); dative 'to' (a mí dedes); haber a + inf. 'have to' (lo han a far); a + noun of direction (adeliñava a la puerta 'made for the gate') · impersonal 'there is' (aver; es dia a de plazo 'there is (only) a day of the term', the most likely reading of a hard line); ha as auxiliary set after the participle (soñado a 'he has dreamt') · also 'on, at (a time)' (a tercer dia 'on the third day') · also a — 'has' before the participle, agreeing with the object (la lança a quebrada 'he has broken the lance'; a menester 'has need of'); a + dative of the person affected (a Minaya matáronle el cavallo 'they killed Minaya's horse') · a — 'as, for' (tóvoslo a grand fonta 'he took it as a great affront') · also a — 'with' of instrument (a dientes las tomó 'with his teeth he took them'; = con)
